subject: Vendor onboarding: multi-account claim transfer blocking PO visibility for Novum Corp
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novum-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procureops@novum-corp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem: New supplier account prevents PO visibility (coupa)

Hi Mina / Ben,

We're mid-onboarding and Novum's finance team can't see any POs against the vendor profile you've created. Our ops team thinks there are two supplier identities in Coupa (one legacy, one newly-provisioned) and the new one doesn't have the PO-binding claim set. When we try to accept the portal claim it bounces to an earlier account and shows "account already claimed."

Attached a screenshot of the claim flow where the accept button returns us to the legacy profile (screenshot-claim-flow.png). We've also attached a short mutual action plan draft (Novum_MA_plan.xlsx).

Can you: 1) confirm which supplier ID Redwoods' provisioning wrote back to our ERP, and 2) temporarily email any pending POs as PDFs so our AP can process payments while we sort the portal? PO example: PO #4721.

We need a resolution by end of week — our cutover for month-end AP is Friday.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Ops | Novum Corp
procureops@novum-corp.com

---
Attachment(s): screenshot-claim-flow.png (image), Novum_MA_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novum-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@coupa-support.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Problem: New supplier account prevents PO visibility (coupa)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear repro. I dug into our provisioning logs and see two supplier identities:
- supplier_id: S-9931 (legacy, old tenant)
- supplier_id: S-9931-NEW (provisioned via API on 2029-08-12)

It looks like a claim token issued by the old tenant is still active and is being prioritized by Coupa's delegated login handoff, which is re-binding users to the legacy profile. That would explain the "account already claimed" behavior.

Action plan (proposed):
- TEMP: Ben to send the three pending POs (including #4721) to Novum as signed PDFs today so AP can continue processing. (Ben?)
- Short-term fix: I will open a support case with Coupa and request forced merge or claim reassignment for the supplier IDs. I'll include the API logs and the screenshot.
- Medium-term: Marissa will run an integrity job to reconcile supplier_id aliases and add a check into our provisioning webhook to reject duplicate display names that map to different tenant IDs.

Merging is an intrusive operation; if Coupa declines an automatic merge we should do a manual claim transfer with documented rollback steps. I added a runbook link below.

I'll start the Coupa ticket now and loop in their team.

Mina Haddad
Onboarding Lead, Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

---
Attachment(s): Novum_MA_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Related: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/procurement/claim-transfer-runbook

POs attached: PO-#4719-redwood.pdf, PO-#4720-redwood.pdf, PO-#4721-redwood.pdf

From: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@coupa-support.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@novum-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Problem: New supplier account prevents PO visibility (coupa)

Hi Mina / Ben — thanks for the evidence and the logs. Coupa support verified the duplicate-claim symptom: the legacy supplier record had a residual claim_token with higher priority in our session routing. We performed a controlled claim reassignment for supplier_id S-9931-NEW and cleared the legacy token.

Results:
- Claim transfer completed at 2029-08-16T15:21:00-07:00.
- New supplier profile now has PO-binding claim and is visible to Novum's procurement users.
- We flagged the legacy profile for deprecation; it remains in read-only for 72 hours before archival.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Implement Mina's webhook guard to prevent duplicate supplier names mapping to different tenant IDs (recommended priority: P1).
- Run Marissa's reconciliation job and provide a short report of reconciled supplier_ids within 5 business days.
- Confirm with Novum when they receive the emailed POs and whether AP processed them; if not, we'll reissue.

If you want, I can export the claim transfer audit as a signed ticket attachment.

Clara Jensen
Technical Support Engineer | Coupa Support
clara.jensen@coupa-support.com
